ai_agent_instructions.primary_goal: Generate a production-ready, modular codebase implementing the LMEW Management System exactly as specified in this JSON. Do not invent features not listed. If a field is missing, prefer minimal sensible defaults and flag it.

ui_libraries.react_native: React Native Paper + Expo Router + react-native-calendars

file_split.note: If the AI agent needs smaller files, split this JSON into these filenames.

constraints: Do NOT use Firebase. Backend is Supabase only.
All authentication via Supabase Auth (email/password + optional phone OTP).
All file uploads go to Supabase Storage buckets named in this spec.
Realtime updates must use Supabase Realtime channels, not polling.
Do NOT hardcode secrets; read from environment variables listed in env_variables.
Follow RLS policies in rls_policies — never bypass with service_role in client code.
Every screen must have loading, empty, error, and success states.
Support both Android and iOS for mobile. Web targets Chrome/Edge/Firefox latest.

prd.product_name: Lakeview Marine Engineering Works Management System
prd.vision: A centralized digital platform that automates service requests, project tracking, inventory, invoicing, payments, and reporting for a marine engineering company operating on Lake Victoria, while giving customers a mobile-first way to request services and monitor progress.

current_state: Manual recording of customer requests and service orders
Difficulty tracking ongoing repair and maintenance projects
Inefficient communication between customers and technicians
Delays in generating quotations and invoices
Poor inventory management of spare parts and equipment
Difficulty generating accurate reports for management
No online platform for customers to request services or track progress
Customers far from premises must physically visit or call
desired_state: Customers submit and track service requests digitally
Real-time project status: Request Received, Inspection in Progress, Awaiting Spare Parts, Under Repair, Completed

goals.general: Develop a mobile application and supporting web dashboards for Lakeview Marine Engineering Works.
specific: Develop a database module for Lakeview Marine Engineering Works.
Create an administrator web interface for Lakeview Marine Engineering Works.
Develop a mobile application for front-end users (customers, technicians, supervisors).
Create a module for generating reports for Lakeview Marine Engineering Works.

non_goals: No multi-tenant SaaS in v1 (single company)
No offline-first full sync in v1 (basic read cache only)

components.edge_functions: Deno-based Supabase Edge Functions (for payments webhook, PDF generation, scheduled low-stock checks)

mobile_app.payments: M-Pesa Daraja API (via Supabase Edge Function) + Stripe optional

shared.types: packages/shared-types (generated from Supabase via supabase gen types typescript)
shared.validators: zod schemas shared across all clients

system_architecture.high_level: Three client apps (mobile, admin web, staff web) share one Supabase project and one shared-types package. All business logic that must be trusted (payments, PDF, scheduled jobs) lives in Edge Functions. RLS enforces per-role data access.

environments.dev: Supabase local (supabase start) + Expo dev client
environments.staging: Supabase cloud project (staging) + EAS internal build + Vercel previews
environments.production: Supabase cloud project (prod) + EAS production build + Vercel prod

service_request_submission: Mobile: customer fills form -> zod validation -> insert into service_requests
Trigger: insert into service_request_status_history with status 'request_received'
Admin React: subscribes to channel, sees new request instantly
Service Manager assigns to technician -> work_orders row created
payment_flow: Customer taps Pay on invoice in mobile
Edge Function calls Daraja STK Push
Daraja callback hits Edge Function mpesa-callback
Edge Function updates payments + invoices atomically
Realtime pushes update to customer mobile + Finance dashboard

role_storage.enforcement: Postgres enum + RLS policies + client-side guards

profiles.description: One row per authenticated user; extends auth.users.
profiles.trigger: on auth.users insert -> create profile row (via trigger handle_new_user)

customers.description: Extra customer info linked to profiles; receptionist may create without auth account (walk-in).

messages.description: Threaded messages between customer and assigned staff on a service request.

company_info.description: Single-row table for About Us / Contact Us content.

functions_and_triggers.name: decrement_stock_on_work_order_part
functions_and_triggers.action: insert stock_movement out + update inventory quantity

functions_and_triggers.name: notify_low_stock
functions_and_triggers.action: if quantity_on_hand <= reorder_level -> insert notifications for store_manager + administrator

principles: Default deny: no policy = no access.
Use auth.uid() and (select role from profiles where id = auth.uid()) as the primary predicates.
Never trust client-supplied role; always look it up server-side.

policies.name: vessels_customer_own
policies.using: customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE profile_id = auth.uid()) OR public.current_role() IN ('administrator','service_manager','technician','supervisor')

policies.name: sr_customer_own
policies.using: customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE profile_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: sr_customer_create
policies.with_check: customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE profile_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: sr_technician_assigned
policies.using: id IN (SELECT service_request_id FROM work_orders WHERE assigned_to = auth.uid())

policies.name: q_customer_own
policies.using: service_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM service_requests WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE profile_id = auth.uid()))

policies.name: inv_customer_own
policies.using: customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE profile_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: pay_customer_own
policies.using: invoice_id IN (SELECT id FROM invoices WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE profile_id = auth.uid()))

policies.name: pay_customer_create
policies.with_check: invoice_id IN (SELECT id FROM invoices WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE profile_id = auth.uid()))

policies.name: po_supplier_own
policies.using: supplier_id IN (SELECT id FROM suppliers WHERE profile_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: fb_customer_own
policies.using: customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE profile_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: msg_participants
policies.using: service_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM service_requests WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE profile_id = auth.uid())) OR public.current_role() IN ('administrator','service_manager','supervisor') OR service_request_id IN (SELECT service_request_id FROM work_orders WHERE assigned_to = auth.uid())

helper_function.name: public.current_role
helper_function.body: SELECT role FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()

api_spec.note: Supabase is the API. Use the JS client. Below are the primary client calls per feature. Edge Functions are HTTP endpoints.

realtime: supabase.channel('sr:' + id).on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'service_requests', filter: 'id=eq.' + id }, cb).subscribe()
supabase.channel('user:' + uid).on('postgres_changes', { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'notifications', filter: 'user_id=eq.' + uid }, cb).subscribe()

testing.strategy: Acceptance testing (per proposal) plus layered automated testing.
critical_test_cases: Customer cannot read another customer's service requests (RLS).
Technician can only update work orders assigned to them.
Store manager sees low-stock notification after stock drops below reorder level.
Invoice balance updates after M-Pesa payment callback.
Quotation totals recalculate when line items change.
Realtime status change appears on customer mobile within 2 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end flow: create request -> assign -> quote -> approve -> work -> invoice -> pay -> feedback.
No P1 bugs open at UAT sign-off.
All PDFs render correctly with company branding.
